name: Indianapolis Parts Distribution Center - Whitestown IN

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via web research as the 283,500 sq ft Indianapolis PDC at 4140 Anson Boulevard, AllPoints at Anson park, opened 2017 by DTNA ($12.35M lease/build). Roster rooftop geocode moved only 181 m and landed on the correct building. Center locked at 39.979000, -86.386300.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No perimeter fence, no barrier arm, no gate, no checkpoint at any road connection. Street View (2023-05) along Anson Boulevard shows open grass frontage and open driveways. Standard open spec-park layout.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure beside any driveway. A green utility transformer cabinet sits in the south grass (not a guard shack).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: All dock doors on the south long face. Counting the door rhythm and trailers backed in across both halves of the south face gives roughly 30-38 doors; estimate 34, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Active facility: ~15-20 trailers backed into docks plus a row of ~12-15 parked trailers in the south truck court — a clear trailer drop/parking row, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Counted approximately 32 trailers total in captured imagery (backed-in plus the parking row).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide perimeter truck court / loop drive easily holds 3+ trucks staging before docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide, fully paved truck court with unused apron width — room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two open driveway connections to Anson Boulevard (one near the NE office/car-park area, one toward the south truck court) act as separate in/out routes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the dense AllPoints at Anson industrial park, near I-65 in metro Indianapolis; classified Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
